k_means.name: K-Means
k_means.distance_assumption: Euclidean on geographic coordinate plane (Cartesian approximation)
k_means.noise_handling: Forces all outliers into the nearest centroid
k_means.hyperparameters: K (number of clusters must be chosen a priori)
k_means.primary_use_case: Partitioning entire geography into administrative or operational service zones

dbscan.name: DBSCAN
dbscan.distance_assumption: True Haversine spherical distance on Earth's surface
dbscan.cluster_geometry: Arbitrary geometric shapes following actual freeway corridors and intersections
dbscan.noise_handling: Explicitly separates isolated rural accidents as noise (0.18% isolated)
dbscan.computational_speed: Requires BallTree spatial indexing O(n log n)
dbscan.primary_use_case: Pinpointing genuine high-density accident corridors and dense highway blackspots
